name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.7.0: Windows 11 verification pass — DPI-aware hairlines for 125%/150% display scaling, density-corrected filigree strokes, host-aligned scrollbar width, Windows caption-row awareness, Contrast Themes (forced-colors) support, reduced-motion splash skip, throttled re-tagging, and Palatino Linotype in the SVG ornament lettering. v0.6.3 fixes the native Platform WebContentsView layout under the dialog theme; v0.6.2 adds account/Platform dialog click and splash guards; v0.6.1 fixes blank file-card icons and maps expanded reasoning-row icons; v0.6.0 redesigns changed-file/deliverable card frames and maps expanded ToolRow icons; v0.5.3 updates the startup title to 铸造圣殿; v0.5.2 redesigns the deep-diving and conversation-process icons; v0.5.1 fixes the composer unmount / removeChild crash after sending; v0.5.0 adds the Forge-Cathedral startup ignition splash; v0.4.2 fixes icon restoration when the plugin is disabled. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。 Verified on a real Windows 11 machine at 100%/125%/150% scaling, Windows Snap widths and Contrast Themes.
